review_candidates.title: Network Security Engineer
review_candidates.description: We are seeking a senior technical leader for the Network Security Engineer . You will define the strategy, architecture, engineering, automation, and lifecycle management of Ford’s global network security platforms. Your work will advance Zero Trust and SASE, strengthen cloud and enterprise connectivity, and help ensure network services are secure, resilient, and highly available. This role combines deep network security expertise with architecture leadership, automation, operational discipline, and collaboration across global teams. You will partner with engineering and operations teams, business stakeholders, and technology providers to modernize network security and support Ford’s enterprise, manufacturing, cloud, supplier, dealer, and partner environments. Network Security Strategy, Architecture & Modernization Define the enterprise network security architecture and technology roadmap. Lead strategy for Zero Trust, Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), Prisma Access, firewalls, proxies, Cisco ISE, SD-WAN, wireless, DNS/DHCP/IPAM, and F5 technologies. Design secure, reliable connectivity for Ford’s enterprise, manufacturing, cloud, supplier, dealer, and partner environments. Modernize legacy VPN and DMZ architectures by advancing Zero Trust access models. Establish and maintain security standards, governance practices, and compliance approaches for network security platforms. Partner with technical teams and technology providers—including Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, and F5—to evaluate capabilities, guide implementation, and plan platform lifecycles. Security Engineering, Automation & Risk Reduction Drive network security engineering and platform improvements in partnership with development and infrastructure teams. Advance network automation and Infrastructure as Code practices to improve consistency, efficiency, and reliability. Lead or coordinate remediation of security vulnerabilities, including urgent and zero-day risks. Apply Agentic AI automation where appropriate to improve security operations and engineering workflows. Champion Full Stack Observability (FSO) and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices to strengthen service health and operational insight. Operations, Availability & Incident Leadership Support major incidents, change management, technical escalations, and enterprise network security operations. Help ensure 24x7 availability of global network security services through Follow-the-Sun operations. Collaborate with global operations teams to maintain secure, resilient, and highly available platforms. Provide technical direction during complex troubleshooting and network security issues. Technical Leadership & Collaboration Provide technical leadership and mentorship to network security engineers. Build strong working relationships across network, cloud, security, infrastructure, manufacturing, and operations teams. Coordinate with internal teams and technology partners to align architecture, engineering, and operational practices. Communicate technical strategies, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly to technical and business stakeholders. We recognize that no one person will embody every quality or skill listed below. If you bring deep network security experience and are motivated to modernize and protect complex enterprise environments, we encourage you to apply. Education Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field—or equivalent relevant experience. Preferred degree: Bachelor of Technology. Experience 12+ years of enterprise IT experience. 6+ years of network security engineering experience. Experience defining or implementing enterprise network security architecture, technology strategy, or platform roadmaps. Experience supporting enterprise-scale network environments and operational processes. Experience with network automation, incident management, problem management, and change management. Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, troubleshoot complex issues, and collaborate across engineering and operations teams. Experience mentoring engineers or providing technical direction in a complex environment. Required Technical Experience Strong expertise in Palo Alto firewalls, Prisma Access, Cisco Umbrella, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), SASE, and intrusion prevention/detection systems (IPS/IDS). Hands-on experience with Cisco ISE, SD-WAN/SDN, F5 load balancers, and DNS/DHCP/IP address management (IPAM), including TCPWave. Strong knowledge of routing, switching, LAN/WAN, MPLS, IPsec VPN, and DMZ architecture. Proficiency with Wireshark and network packet analysis. Experience with enterprise network operations, technical escalations, incident response, and change management. Experience with network automation and Infrastructure as Code practices. Ability to assess network security risks and vulnerabilities, prioritize remediation, and communicate technical impact. Relevant certifications, such as Cisco CCNA, CCNP, or CCIE and Palo Alto certifications such as PCNSE, PCSE, or PCSP. Preferred Experience Experience with Agentic AI automation for network security engineering or operations. Experience with Full Stack Observability and Site Reliability Engineering practices. Experience modernizing legacy network access and security architectures. Experience supporting global, 24x7 enterprise environments and Follow-the-Sun operations. Experience working with technology partners such as Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, and F5. You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply! As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including: Immediate medical, dental, and prescription drug coverage Flexible family care, parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more Vehicle discount program for employees and family members, and management leases Tuition assistance Established and active employee resource groups Paid time off for individual and team community service A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time. Deep knowledge of IPSec VPN, BGP, NAT, High Availability, routing, and firewall security policies. Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure networking, including VNet, vWAN, UDR, routing, and cloud-hosted firewall architectures. Solid knowledge of network security architecture, TCP/IP, routing, segmentation, VPN technologies, and enterprise connectivity. review_candidates.title: Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description: About Us Rockwater Group is a management company that provides Finance, Human Resources, Technology, Marketing, and other shared services to Rockwater Tax, our technology-enabled professional services business delivering tax and accounting services, and TaxRock, our technology business that provides innovative solutions that modernize how tax services are delivered. Together, our businesses combine deep industry expertise with technology to create better, more efficient ways to serve our customers. The Role Rockwater Group is looking for a hands-on Systems Administrator who isn't afraid to dig in! You'll keep our technology humming day to day: Microsoft 365 and Azure, identity and access, laptops and networks, security tools, and the business systems our teams live in. You'll report directly to our VP of Technology. We have a solid infrastructure and want someone who brings curiosity, follow-through, and a “let me take a look” attitude. You know the person who hears “the printer's acting weird” and is already behind it with a flashlight before anyone finishes the sentence? That's who we're looking for. This role is on-site in our Carlsbad office five days a week, Monday through Friday. Most of our team works in the office, so you'll be the go-to tech person down the hall, while also supporting a smaller group of remote teammates across the country. Because we handle taxpayer data, security isn't a side project here. It's part of the job. This is a great next step for a systems administrator, MSP engineer, or senior IT support specialist who's ready to own an environment, not just a ticket queue. As we grow, this role can grow with you, with a clear path toward a senior systems or IT operations position. What You'll Do Administer our Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online, and Azure environment, including configuration standards, licensing, and tenant security. Manage identity and access: SSO, MFA, conditional access, provisioning, and the full account lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding. Own endpoints from procurement to retirement, including imaging and Autopilot, Windows Update and patch policy, endpoint protection, and RMM coverage on every corporate device. Enforce our security policies, manage email security filtering, and support vulnerability assessments, outside penetration testing, incident response, and disaster recovery planning. Administer our business systems, including Salesforce, HubSpot, Box, QuickBooks Online, document management, and our tax and financial software, managing access, integrations, and license optimization. Be the first call (and the friendly face) for IT questions, running a consistent help desk with clear SLAs for tickets, onboarding, and deprovisioning. Manage the network, managed switches, and on-site equipment in Carlsbad, as well as our cloud telephony platform. Maintain the approved-tool list and acceptable-use standards for AI and other third-party software, including what firm and client data may be entered into outside systems. Build an internal knowledge base so the same question never has to be answered twice, and help deliver security awareness training for all employees. Partner with the VP of Technology on technology planning, vendor evaluation, and new implementations. What Success Looks Like First 90 days: open every closet and close the gaps. You will: Complete a Microsoft 365 tenant audit and a full device and license inventory. Review our security and RMM platforms, and use Intune to find where software deployment has drifted. Review Windows Update and patch management policies and bring them to standard. Get endpoint protection and RMM agents deployed consistently across every corporate device, so we know exactly what we own and what is protected. Months 4–6: learn how the business actually runs. You will: Come up to speed on Salesforce, HubSpot, document management, and our tax and financial software, with dedicated time and support from our VP of Technology. Map how work moves between departments and where our systems hand off to one another, and identify where the friction is. Months 7–12: go from fixing to improving. You will: Shift from maintaining to improving through documentation, project work, new implementations, and user training. Contribute ideas to our technology roadmap alongside the VP of Technology, bringing what you have learned about our systems and our people. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 3+ years in IT support or systems administration, in roles such as Systems Administrator, MSP Engineer, Senior IT Support Specialist, or Help Desk Lead. Hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Intune in a cloud-based environment supporting both in-office and remote users. Hands-on experience with Intune device management, including Autopilot and app deployment. Working knowledge of networking (switching, VLANs, firewalls, VPN), endpoint security, and RMM tools. Strong hands-on troubleshooting skills across devices, accounts, and applications. Sound judgment about data handling and privacy, including what is and is not appropriate to put into third-party tools. Clear communication with both technical and non-technical people. Experience in a regulated or professional services environment (tax, accounting, legal, healthcare) is a plus. PowerShell or other scripting and automation experience is a plus. Salesforce administration experience is a plus. Microsoft certifications such as MD-102, MS-102, or AZ-104 are a plus. Who You Are Not afraid to dig in. A tangled switch closet or a half-documented Intune policy doesn't scare you. You roll up your sleeves and figure it out. An owner. When you find a gap, you close it and leave good notes for whoever comes next. Security-minded. You treat client data like it's your own and build guardrails people can actually follow. A translator. You can explain an MFA rollout to a tax partner without anyone's eyes glazing over. Curious about the business. You want to know how work actually gets done, not just how the systems are configured. Calm under pressure. When every laptop in the office decides to update at 8:59 a.m., you're the steady one in the room. Service-oriented. A remote teammate across the country gets the same level of support as the person at the next desk. Compensation & Benefits Medical, dental, and vision insurance. The company pays 75% of employee premiums. 401(k) with a safe harbor match: 100% of the first 3% and 50% of the next 2% Paid time off and paid holidays Paid company closure the final week of the year
